description: Preview, edit and export Markdown to PDF and RTF.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Raw HTML and custom stylesheets are disabled in untrusted workspaces.
config.preview.theme.auto: Follow the VS Code color theme.
config.preview.customCss: Stylesheets added to the preview. Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder.
config.preview.scrollSync: Synchronize scrolling between the editor and the preview.
config.markdown.allowHtml: Render raw HTML in Markdown (sanitized). Ignored in untrusted workspaces.
config.export.profile: Layout of exported PDF and RTF files. A document can choose its own with `perfil: abnt` (or `profile:`) in its front matter.
config.export.profile.default: GitHub-like layout, following the font and page settings below.
config.export.profile.abnt: Formal document following the ABNT rules (NBR 14724, 6024, 10520): A4, 3/2 cm margins, Times New Roman 12 pt, justified 1.5-spaced text, numbered sections, footnotes and page numbers. Ignores the page, font size and header/footer settings.
config.export.outputDir: Folder for exported files. Supports `${fileDirname}` and `${workspaceFolder}`; relative paths resolve against the Markdown file.
config.export.askLocation: Ask where to save each export instead of using the output folder.
config.export.pageSize: Page size for PDF and RTF exports.
config.export.landscape: Use landscape orientation for PDF and RTF exports.
config.export.margin: Page margins as a CSS length or shorthand, e.g. `20mm` or `15mm 20mm`.
config.export.fontFamily: Body font for PDF and RTF exports. Empty: the system default (Segoe UI on Windows, Helvetica Neue on macOS, DejaVu Sans on Linux).
config.export.codeFontFamily: Monospace font for code in PDF and RTF exports. Empty: the system default (Consolas, Menlo, DejaVu Sans Mono).
config.export.fontSize: Body font size in points for PDF and RTF exports. Empty (the default): sized so each line holds as much text as the preview, which then wraps in the same places (about 8 pt on A4 with 20 mm margins).
config.pdf.header: Text centered at the top of every PDF page. Placeholders: `{page}`, `{pages}`, `{title}`, `{date}`. Empty for no header.
config.pdf.footer: Text centered at the bottom of every PDF page (same placeholders as the header). Empty for no footer.
config.editor.listContinuation: Pressing Enter in a list item starts the next item; on an empty item it ends the list.
config.editor.formatTables: Provide a Markdown formatter (Format Document / Format Selection) that aligns tables.
config.toc.minLevel: Smallest heading level included in the table of contents.
config.toc.maxLevel: Largest heading level included in the table of contents.
config.toc.updateOnSave: Update the table of contents between `<!-- toc -->` and `<!-- tocstop -->` when saving.
